evals.prompt: Use the supplied Daily context and current Weekly Draft. Directly update the Draft with the grounded Decision and current employee workflow observations.
evals.expected_output: The existing Draft gains a source-keyed Proposed Decision and a reconstructable current-workflow observation with explicit measurement gaps; no contribution file or provider action is created.
assertions: Cites notion://TASK-201 and notion://TASK-203 with those source IDs from the context
Adds the TASK-201 Decision and TASK-203 workflow observation only with source-ID/kind keys
The workflow states trigger, actors/handoff, ordered steps, systems, frequency/volume, timing, exception, output, evidence/confidence, and promotion state
Preserves the missing accountable decision authority plus unmeasured active time, wait time, weekly volume, SKU volume, rework, and loaded cost as explicit gaps
Edits the supplied current Draft directly and creates no contribution or diff file
Does not write PM control, Project memory, promotion, or provider effects

metadata.title: Daily evidence enters the current Weekly Draft directly

evals.prompt: The context contains an AI-summary suggestion but no observed current method, concrete choice, source evidence, authority, or proof. Update the current Weekly Draft correctly.
evals.expected_output: Returns no_finding or a named source gap and leaves the Draft unchanged; it does not invent a Decision, workflow, authority, timing, or generic wiki item.
assertions: Rejects the generic suggestion as neither a Decision nor an observed workflow
Names missing choice, observed steps, evidence, authority, and proof without filling them in
Leaves every Draft anchor unchanged and creates no intermediate artifact or provider action

assertions: Does not search for or infer another Weekly Draft
Preserves the exact missing-target gap and source context
